purpose: Drei Bildvorschläge für Trevors erste Cenyric-Schiffskatze
userRequirements: Cocky, frech, aktiv und leicht zerzaust

variants.title: 1 · Der Kistenfrechdachs
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Aleria fantasy animal companion portrait, ONE individual Cenyric ship cat belonging to Sir Trevor Gwyvern aboard the medieval cog Tiefenwyrm. This is one candidate design of the FIRST cat, not a group of cats. Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Subject requirements: A healthy, active, medium-sized young adult natural domestic cat with a balanced compact athletic build. ORANGE TABBY FUR with darker orange ginger stripes on head, back, legs and tail, and a distinctly PURE WHITE lower chest, belly and underside. The orange tabby and white belly are defining breed markings and must be clearly readable. Slightly tousled, wind-ruffled short-to-medium fur with uneven lively tufts at cheeks, chest and nape; rustic well-loved ship cat. Cocky, cheeky, alert, confident body language, bright eyes, raised chin and forward or attentively turned ears. Strong, lively stance and springy readiness to move. Natural feline anatomy and expressions.
Composition: ONE complete cat is the clear large foreground subject, all paws and the entire tail inside frame, about 75 percent of image height, generous small margins. Cat portrait with simple ship context, not a detailed ship scene. Warm daylight, muted wooden deck, a quiet soft blue sea background and only the stated prop. Crisp readable cat silhouette and lively anime character expression, simplified cel-shaded fur masses rather than detailed individual hairs.
Constraints: Natural quadrupedal cat, no clothing, costume, bandana, collar, weapon, hat, human hands, human mouth, people, extra animals, text, lettering, watermark, panel borders or collage. No drooping posture, sad or weary expression, sleepy eyes, slumped shoulders, obesity, gauntness, injury, grime or matted neglected fur. No gray, brown tabby, black or tortoiseshell coat; preserve ORANGE stripes and WHITE belly.
Variant 1: Rich warm rusty ORANGE tabby with a pure white bib merging into a broad WHITE BELLY, white chin and toes, bright AMBER eyes. Slightly stronger cheek tufts and a windswept little tuft on top of the head. Standing proudly and securely on a plain low wooden ship's crate, chest lifted and forepaws planted apart, hindquarters angled slightly away. Three-quarter frontal view lets us see the white chest and white underside. Tail held high with a jaunty bent tip. Head slightly tilted, an impudent self-satisfied feline side-eye toward the viewer, as if caught stealing fish and utterly unrepentant. This cat feels bold, sturdy, energetic and cheeky. Minimal crate and deck, distant blue sea, no other props.
